name: golden-rmc-6
source: pynmea2 1.19.0: pynmea2.RMC('GP', 'RMC', fields).render, then pynmea2.parse of that sentence for the model values. Written by tools/gen/golden-pynmea2.py; no engine is run.
reference: NMEA 0183 RMC as pynmea2 reads it: latitude and longitude from ddmm.mmmmm and dddmm.mmmmm with the hemisphere, time from hhmmss.ss and the date ddmmyy. Field text is written in the pack's canonical forms (packs/nmea0183/pack.def), so the sentence round-trips unchanged.
